regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a broad (8/16 eligible) rotation with Oil & Gas Producers as a crowded leader (score 2.24, crowding_z 1.18) and Big Banks as a durable challenger (durability 0.71, trend, uncrowded). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge here and the backtest confirms momentum rank has ~0 forward alpha, so the note must stay a focus/risk lens. Track record shows only 0.316 directional accuracy on 117 calls, so conviction defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watch Silver & Royalties: currently ineligible (durability 0.10, breadth 0.0, mean-revert), but if XGD.TO flips eligible while Silver & Royalties breadth rises above 0.5 and durability clears 0.5, the precious-metals complex could be re-forming leadership — this would retire the current Gold Miners avoid.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the highest-ranked theme that is simultaneously eligible, trend-tagged (hurst_tag=trend), uncrowded (crowding_z 0.44, crowded=false), and has a strong durability bar (0.71) and broad participation (breadth 0.857). Unlike the leader O&G, it does not carry a crowding caution, so the absolute-trend gate can work without a size-down flag. This is a relative-leadership lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks are highly sensitive to Canadian housing/credit cycle and rate-path surprises; a macro risk-off or spike in credit stress would hit Financials broadly despite the internal trend health, and the rank gap to O&G (margin 1.393) shows the market is not yet confirming a handoff into Banks.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags the S&P/TSX benchmark by more than 3% before the check-by date while O&G keeps making new relative highs.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The leader (rank 1, score 2.24) has eligibility, broad participation (breadth 0.929), and a mixed-to-positive durability read (bar 0.69), but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.18). The crowding flag is a size-down caution only, per guardrails — never a fade. Given the track record's poor directional accuracy, the lean stays low-conviction: stay with the durable-but-downsized leader, not against it.
evidence: crowding_z 1.18, crowded=true (caution to size down, not fade)
theses.dissent: Crowded energy leadership has historically marked attention/flow peaks rather than further upside (the detector's own guardrails note inflows often mark tops), and a crude-oil price reversal or global-demand shock would hit the crowded leader hardest.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by more than 5% before the check-by date while breadth drops below 0.70.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is ineligible (eligible=false) with a collapsed durability bar (0.14) and zero breadth (0.0), despite being scorable via XGD.TO. This is exactly the profile the absolute-trend gate is designed to avoid: no staying power, no participation. The avoid lean is defensive, not a short or fade call.
theses.dissent: A risk-off shock or a sudden safe-haven bid could reignite gold miners sharply, and the low crowding (z -0.34) means there is no reflexive downside from positioning.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by more than 8% and clears the absolute-trend gate (eligible flips true) before the check-by date.
